description: The file '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/InvisibilityCloak.csv' is already open in Jamovi. This dataset comes from a field experiment (Field, 2013) investigating whether wearing an invisibility cloak affects mischievous behavior. Variables: 'Mischief' (count of mischievous acts) and 'Cloak' (0 = no cloak, 1 = wearing cloak). Click 'T-Tests' in the top menu bar and select 'Independent Samples T-Test'. Move 'Mischief' to the 'Dependent Variables' box and 'Cloak' to the 'Grouping Variable' box. Under 'Additional Statistics', enable 'Effect size' (Cohen's d) and 'Descriptives'. Leave the hypothesis as 'Group 1 ≠ Group 2' (two-tailed).
